name: Barbell Bench Press
cue:
Lie down with your eyes under the bar and your feet planted on the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with your elbows at about 45°.
Press up without bouncing off your chest.
Common mistake: lifting your hips off the bench. If you go heavy, ask someone to spot you.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
cue: Bench at 30–45°; lower to your upper chest with elbows at 45°.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
cue: Secure your feet; lower under control to your lower chest.

name: Wide-Grip Bench Press
cue: Grip wider than your shoulders; short, controlled range.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cue:
Lie on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand at chest height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and plant your feet.
Press up, bringing the dumbbells together without clanking them.
Lower slowly to the sides of your chest.
Common mistake: flaring your elbows out to 90° from your body.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cue:
Bench at 30–45° with a dumbbell in each hand at chest height.
Shoulder blades together and feet planted.
Press up and slightly inward.
Lower slowly to your upper chest.
Common mistake: setting the bench too steep (it works your shoulders more).

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
cue: Control the way down; keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Press
cue: Palms facing each other; elbows close to your torso.

name: Incline Hammer-Grip Dumbbell Press
cue: Palms facing each other on an incline bench; full range of motion.
imageNote: Here your palms face each other (hammer grip).

name: Machine Chest Press
cue:
Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Back against the pad and shoulder blades together.
Press until your arms are almost straight, without locking your elbows.
Return slowly until you feel your chest stretch.
Common mistake: lifting your shoulders off the pad.

name: Lever Chest Press
cue: Back against the pad; press without snapping your elbows into lockout.

name: Incline Machine Press
cue:
Set the seat so the handles reach your upper chest.
Back against the pad.
Press until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly without letting the plates slam.
Common mistake: shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.

name: Decline Machine Press
cue: Press in line with your lower chest.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
cue: Position the bench so the bar comes down to your mid chest.

name: Smith Machine Incline Press
cue: Incline bench; lower to your collarbone under control.

name: Smith Machine Decline Press
cue: Lower toward your lower chest without bouncing.

name: Dumbbell Fly
cue: Elbows slightly bent; open until you feel a stretch and close in an arc.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
cue: Bench at 30°; hugging motion, without going too deep.

name: Decline Dumbbell Fly
cue: Wide, controlled arc; don't lock your elbows.

name: Pec Deck (Machine Fly)
cue: Chest up; bring the handles together and squeeze your chest for 1 second.

name: Cable Crossover
cue: Step forward; bring your hands together low and in front of your body.

name: Low-to-High Cable Crossover
cue: Pulleys low; raise your hands in an arc up to chest height.

name: Flat Bench Cable Fly
cue: Constant tension; open to chest level.
imageNote: The image shows dumbbells; here you use cables.

name: Incline Cable Fly
cue: Incline bench between the cables; wide, slow arc.
imageNote: The image shows dumbbells; here you use cables.

name: Single-Arm Cable Crossover
cue: Cross your hand in front of your body, squeezing your chest.

name: Cable Chest Press
cue: Stand with one foot forward; press straight ahead without arching your back.

name: Incline Cable Chest Press
cue: Press up and forward on a diagonal.
imageNote: The image shows dumbbells; here you use a cable.

name: Push-Up
cue:
Hands a little wider than your shoulders and body straight like a plank.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Lower your chest almost to the floor with your elbows about 45° from your body.
Push until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: letting your hips sag; if it's too hard, do them from your knees.

name: Wide Push-Up
cue: Hands wider than your shoulders; body in a straight line.

name: Incline Push-Up
cue: Hands on a bench or wall; an easier version to start with.

name: Decline Push-Up
cue:
Feet on a step or low bench and hands on the floor.
Body straight from heels to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor under control.
Push until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: letting your hips sag.

name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
cue:
Feet on a bench and hands on the floor, a little wider than your shoulders.
Body straight and abs tight.
Lower your chest under control and push until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: piking your hips up to make it easier.

name: Chest Dip
cue: Lean your torso forward and lower until you feel a stretch in your chest.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
cue: Arms almost straight; lower behind your head under control.

name: Svend Press
cue: Squeeze the plate between your palms and extend your arms forward.

name: Barbell Floor Press
cue: Lying on the floor; your elbows touch the floor gently on every rep.

name: Pull-Up
cue:
Hang from the bar with palms facing away, a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulders down and brace your abs before you pull.
Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: swinging or doing half reps.

name: Chin-Up
cue: Palms facing you; chest to the bar and a controlled descent.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
cue: The band helps at the bottom; same range as a pull-up.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
cue: Use a dip belt with a plate; same technique as a regular pull-up.

name: V-Grip Pull-Up
cue: Close neutral grip; pull your chest toward the handle.
imageNote: The image shows separate parallel handles; here you use the V-handle with your hands together.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
cue:
Adjust the pad so your thighs are locked in.
Grip the bar wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Chest up and pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Go back up slowly until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: leaning way back or pulling the bar behind your neck.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
cue: Narrow grip; elbows tucked and driving down.

name: V-Bar Lat Pulldown
cue: Bring the handle to your sternum, squeezing your back.

name: Underhand Lat Pulldown
cue: Palms facing you; pull with your elbows, not your hands.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
cue: Pull your elbow toward the hip on the same side.

name: Full-Range Lat Pulldown
cue: Stretch fully at the top and squeeze at the bottom.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
cue: Arms almost straight; bring the bar to your thighs using your lats.

name: Rope Straight-Arm Pulldown
cue: Spread the rope at the end, next to your hips.
imageNote: The image shows a bar; here you use the rope.

name: Barbell Row
cue:
Grip the bar with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Hinge to about 45° with a straight back and slightly bent knees.
Pull the bar toward your belly button, driving your elbows back.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: standing up to pull or rounding your back.

name: Underhand Barbell Row
cue: Palms up; elbows close to your body.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cue:
Rest the hand and knee of the same side on a bench; your back stays flat.
Hold the dumbbell in the other hand with your arm hanging.
Drive your elbow toward your hip, close to your body.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Common mistake: twisting your torso to lift the weight.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
cue:
A dumbbell in each hand; hinge forward with a flat back.
Knees slightly bent and arms hanging.
Pull both dumbbells toward your stomach, driving your elbows back.
Lower slowly.
Common mistake: rounding your back or pulling only with your arms.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cue: Chest on the incline bench; squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.

name: Seated Cable Row
cue: Back straight; bring the handle to your stomach and squeeze your shoulder blades.

name: Single-Arm Seated Cable Row
cue: Rotate your torso slightly on the stretch; pull with your elbow.

name: High Cable Row
cue: Pull toward your upper chest with elbows flared.
imageNote: The image shows a low seated cable row; here you pull toward your upper chest with your elbows flared.

name: T-Bar Row
cue: Chest out, neutral spine; bring the handle to your lower chest.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
cue:
Chest pressed firmly against the pad and feet planted.
Grab the handles with your arms straight.
Pull, driving your elbows back, and squeeze your back at the end.
Lower under control.
Common mistake: lifting your chest off the pad.
imageNote: The image shows a different chest-supported row machine; the movement is the same.

name: Machine High Row
cue: Pull with your elbows back and down.
imageNote: The image shows a chest-supported row; here you pull from above on the high-row machine.

name: Machine Row
cue:
Set the seat so the handles line up with your chest.
Chest against the pad.
Pull the handles, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: pulling your chest off the pad to row.

name: Smith Machine Row
cue: Neutral spine; bar to your stomach.

name: Inverted Row
cue:
Lie under a low bar (or a sturdy table) and grip it shoulder-width apart.
Body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: letting your hips sag. To make it easier, bend your knees.

name: Chest-Supported Barbell Row
cue: Chest on the bench; pull the bar toward the bench, squeezing your shoulder blades.
imageNote: The image shows dumbbells; here you use a barbell.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Row
cue: Pull the end of the bar toward your hip.
imageNote: The image shows the two-handed row; here you do it one arm at a time.

name: Deadlift
cue: Bar close to your legs, neutral spine; push the floor away and extend your hips.

name: Sumo Deadlift
cue: Very wide stance, toes out; knees track over your feet.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cue: Stand inside the bar; push with your legs and extend your hips.

name: Deficit Deadlift
cue: Stand on a plate; longer range with a neutral spine.

name: Rack Pull
cue: Bar at knee height; drive your hips forward hard.

name: Back Extension
cue: Lower with a neutral spine and come up until your body is in line, without overextending.

name: Stability Ball Back Extension
cue: Stomach on the ball; rise slowly until your body is in line.
imageNote: The image shows a back extension bench; here you do it on a stability ball.

name: Barbell Good Morning
cue: Soft knees; push your hips back while keeping your back straight.

name: Overhead Press
cue:
Standing, bar on your upper chest and hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and abs.
Press the bar up, keeping it close to your face.
Once it passes your forehead, move your head under the bar and straighten your arms.
Common mistake: arching your lower back.

name: Seated Barbell Overhead Press
cue: Back supported; lower the bar to your chin.

name: Barbell Shoulder Press
cue: Forearms vertical; press in a straight line.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue: Elbows under your wrists; press up without clanking the dumbbells.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue:
Upright backrest and dumbbells at shoulder height.
Back against the pad and abs tight.
Press up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower under control to ear height.
Common mistake: clanking the dumbbells at the top or arching your back.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue: Tight core, without arching your back.

name: Arnold Press
cue: Start with your palms facing you and rotate as you press.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
cue:
Set the seat so the handles line up with your shoulders.
Back against the pad.
Press up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly to ear height.
Common mistake: arching your back to press.

name: Lever Shoulder Press
cue: Press without lifting your back off the pad.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
cue: Bar in front of your face; press until almost locked out.

name: Cable Shoulder Press
cue: Press up while keeping tension.
imageNote: The image shows dumbbells; here you use cables.

name: Push Press
cue: Dip your knees slightly and use the drive to press the bar up.

name: Seated Kettlebell Press
cue: Straight wrist; press vertically.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cue:
Standing, dumbbells at your sides and elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows, not your hands.
Lower slowly, over 2 or 3 seconds.
Common mistake: swinging your body or shrugging.

name: Seated Lateral Raise
cue: No swinging; raise to shoulder height and lower slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
cue:
Stand sideways to the low pulley and grab the handle with your far hand.
Elbow slightly bent and torso still.
Raise your arm in an arc out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly without letting the cable go slack.
Common mistake: raising above your shoulder or shrugging.

name: Single-Arm Lateral Raise
cue: Hold on to a support and lean slightly away.
imageNote: The image shows both arms; here you do one at a time.

name: Band Lateral Raise
cue: Stand on the band and raise your arms out to the sides.
imageNote: The image shows dumbbells; here you use a band.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
cue: Raise in front up to eye level without swinging.

name: Plate Front Raise
cue: Hold the plate with both hands and raise it in front of you.

name: Cable Front Raise
cue: Low pulley; raise in front with your arm almost straight.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
cue:
Sitting on the end of a bench or standing, hinge forward with a flat back.
Dumbbells hanging under your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Common mistake: pulling with your upper back instead of the back of your shoulders.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
cue:
Sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad.
Grab the handles at shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms back until they line up with your body.
Return slowly without letting the plates slam.
Common mistake: shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
cue: Cross the cables and open back at shoulder height.

name: Seated Rear Delt Raise
cue: Chest close to your thighs; open your arms slowly.
imageNote: The image shows the standing version; here you sit with your chest close to your thighs.

name: Face Pull
cue: Pulley at face height; pull the rope toward your forehead, spreading your hands.

name: Band Pull-Apart
cue: Arms straight in front; pull the band apart to your chest.

name: Barbell Upright Row
cue: Medium grip; raise the bar to your chest with your elbows high.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
cue: Elbows lead the movement; don't go higher than your shoulders.

name: Cable Upright Row
cue: Pull toward your upper chest with your elbows out.

name: Cable External Rotation
cue: Elbow tucked to your side; rotate your forearm outward.

name: Band External Rotation
cue: Elbow at 90° against your side; rotate outward slowly.

name: Handstand Push-Up
cue:
With your back to the wall, put your hands on the floor and walk your feet up the wall.
Hands a little wider than your shoulders and abs tight.
Lower your head toward the floor under control.
Push until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: arching your back a lot; if you can't do them yet, do decline push-ups.

name: Barbell Shrug
cue: Raise your shoulders toward your ears and pause at the top.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cue: Arms straight; raise and lower your shoulders without rolling them.

name: Cable Shrug
cue: Constant tension; pause at the top.
imageNote: The image shows a barbell; here you use a cable.

name: Smith Machine Upright Row
cue: Medium grip; elbows high without going past your shoulders.

name: Machine Shrug
cue: Lift straight up, without rolling your shoulders.

name: Barbell Curl
cue:
Standing, grip the bar with palms facing forward, shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows at your sides the whole time.
Curl the bar toward your chest without moving your elbows forward.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: swinging your torso to lift the weight.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
cue: Grip the angled part; elbows still.

name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Curl
cue: Hands close together; full range of motion.

name: Dumbbell Curl
cue:
Standing, a dumbbell in each hand with your arms straight.
Curl up, turning your palms up, with your elbows fixed at your sides.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Common mistake: raising your elbows or swinging.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
cue: One arm at a time, no swinging.
imageNote: The image shows both arms together; here you alternate.

name: Hammer Curl
cue: Palms facing each other the whole way.

name: Alternating Hammer Curl
cue: Alternate arms; elbows tucked.
imageNote: The image shows both arms together; here you alternate.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
cue: Bring the dumbbell toward the opposite shoulder.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cue: Bench at 45°; arms hanging behind your torso to stretch the biceps.

name: Concentration Curl
cue: Elbow braced on your inner thigh; curl slowly.

name: Barbell Preacher Curl
cue: Arms on the pad; don't drop into lockout at the bottom.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
cue: Arm on the pad; control the way down.

name: Machine Preacher Curl
cue:
Set the seat so your elbow lines up with the machine's pivot.
Rest the backs of your arms on the pad.
Curl until you squeeze your biceps and lower slowly until almost straight.
Common mistake: lifting your elbows off the pad.

name: Machine Biceps Curl
cue: Elbows lined up with the machine's pivot.

name: Cable Biceps Curl
cue: Low pulley; elbows fixed.

name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
cue: Palms facing each other; curl up to your chest.

name: Overhead Cable Curl
cue: Arms at shoulder height; bring your hands toward your head.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
cue: Constant tension through the whole range.
imageNote: The image shows an EZ bar; here you use a cable.

name: Spider Curl
cue: Chest on an incline bench; arms hanging straight down.

name: Drag Curl
cue: Drag the bar up against your torso, driving your elbows back.

name: Zottman Curl
cue: Curl up palms up and lower palms down, slowly.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
cue: Palms down; works the forearm and brachialis.

name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
cue: Back straight; no momentum.

name: Triceps Pushdown
cue: Elbows tucked to your body; extend fully at the bottom.

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
cue:
Facing the high pulley, grab the rope with your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push down until your arms are straight.
At the bottom, spread the rope out to the sides.
Go back up slowly until your forearms are parallel to the floor.
Common mistake: moving your elbows or leaning over the weight.
imageNote: The image shows a bar; here you use the rope.

name: V-Bar Triceps Pushdown
cue: Elbows fixed; only your forearms move.

name: Reverse-Grip Triceps Pushdown
cue: Palms up; elbows tucked.
imageNote: Here your palms face up (underhand grip).

name: Single-Arm Cable Triceps Extension
cue: Extend fully and control the return.

name: Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
cue: Back to the pulley; extend your arms forward and up.

name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
cue: Elbows pointing forward; get a deep stretch behind you.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
cue:
Lying on the bench, hold the EZ bar over your chest with your arms straight.
Keep your elbows fixed, pointing at the ceiling.
Lower the bar toward your forehead, bending only at the elbows.
Extend until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: flaring your elbows or moving your arms back.
imageNote: The image shows a straight bar; here you use an EZ bar.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
cue: Elbows still, pointing at the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
cue: Lower the dumbbells next to your head.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue:
Sitting or standing, hold a dumbbell with both hands over your head.
Elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head, bending only at the elbows.
Extend until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: flaring your elbows out or arching your back.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Dumbbell Extension
cue: Elbow pointing up; lower behind your head.

name: Triceps Kickback
cue: Torso hinged, elbow high; extend your arm back.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cue: Hands shoulder-width apart; elbows tucked.

name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press
cue: Elbows close to your body; lower to your lower chest.
imageNote: The image shows a free barbell; here you use the Smith machine.

name: JM Press
cue: A hybrid of the close-grip press and the skull crusher; lower toward your chin.

name: Triceps Dip
cue: Torso upright; lower until your elbows reach 90° and extend.
imageNote: The image shows the chest version; for triceps keep your torso upright.

name: Parallel Bar Dip
cue: Shoulders down; lower under control.

name: Bench Dip
cue:
Hands on the edge of a bench behind you, fingers pointing forward.
Legs out in front; bend them to make it easier.
Lower by bending your elbows to about 90°, with your back close to the bench.
Push until your arms are straight.
Common mistake: going too deep and straining your shoulders.

name: Weighted Bench Dip
cue: Plate on your thighs; same movement as a bench dip.
imageNote: The image shows the bodyweight version; here you put a plate on your legs.

name: Machine Dip
cue: Push down until your elbows are straight.

name: Machine Triceps Extension
cue:
Set the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot.
Rest your arms on the pad.
Straighten your arms fully and squeeze.
Return slowly until your elbows bend to about 90°.
Common mistake: lifting your elbows off the pad.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
cue: Hands together under your chest; elbows tucked.

name: Close-Grip Dumbbell Press
cue: Dumbbells together; elbows tucked to your torso.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
cue: Forearms on the bench; move only your wrists.

name: Reverse Barbell Wrist Curl
cue: Palms down; raise your knuckles slowly.
imageNote: The image shows dumbbells; here you use a barbell, palms down.

name: Reverse Dumbbell Wrist Curl
cue: Forearms on the bench, palms down; lift with your wrist only.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
cue: Forearms supported, palms up; let the dumbbell roll down and curl up with your wrist.

name: Wrist Roller
cue: Roll up the cord by turning your wrists, arms out in front.

name: Plate Pinch
cue: Pinch the plates with your fingers for as long as you can.

name: Barbell Squat
cue:
Bar on your upper back, not on your neck.
Feet shoulder-width apart with toes turned slightly out.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Go down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor and drive up through your whole foot.
Common mistake: knees caving in or heels lifting. Use the rack's safety bars.

name: Barbell Full Squat
cue: Go as deep as your mobility allows with a neutral spine.

name: Front Squat
cue: Elbows high; torso upright on the way down.

name: Box Squat
cue: Sit briefly on the box without relaxing your core.

name: Smith Machine Squat
cue: Feet slightly forward; lower under control.

name: Goblet Squat
cue:
Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell against your chest.
Feet a little wider than your shoulders.
Squat down as if sitting, with your elbows between your knees.
Drive up through your whole foot with your chest up.
Common mistake: leaning too far forward or lifting your heels.

name: Dumbbell Squat
cue: Dumbbells at your sides; back straight.

name: Bodyweight Squat
cue:
Feet shoulder-width apart and arms in front for balance.
Squat down as if sitting in a chair, chest up.
Knees tracking over your toes and heels down.
Drive up through your whole foot.
Common mistake: knees caving in on the way up.

name: Wide-Stance Barbell Squat
cue: Wider stance, toes out; knees follow your toes.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
cue: Very wide stance; dumbbell hanging in the middle.

name: Zercher Squat
cue: Bar in the crook of your elbows; torso upright.

name: Overhead Squat
cue: Arms locked overhead; requires good mobility.

name: Machine Hack Squat
cue:
Back and shoulders against the pads.
Feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Go deep without lifting your heels.
Drive up through your whole foot without locking your knees.
Common mistake: lifting your lower back off the pad.

name: Barbell Hack Squat
cue: Bar behind your legs; stand up by extending your knees and hips.

name: Leg Press
cue:
Back and hips pressed firmly against the seat.
Feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Lower by bending your knees to about 90°, without lifting your lower back.
Push through your whole foot without locking your knees at the top.
Common mistake: going so deep that your hips lift off the seat.

name: Narrow-Stance Leg Press
cue: Feet together in the middle; targets the quads.

name: Smith Machine Leg Press
cue: Control the descent and don't lock your knees.

name: Leg Extension
cue:
Adjust the backrest so your knee lines up with the machine's pivot.
Place the roller on your ankles and hold the handles.
Straighten your legs fully and squeeze at the top for one second.
Lower slowly without letting the plates slam.
Common mistake: lifting your hips or kicking fast.

name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
cue: One leg at a time; pause at the top.

name: Barbell Lunge
cue: Long step; back knee almost to the floor.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
cue:
Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and your torso upright.
Take a long step forward.
Lower until your back knee almost touches the floor.
Push through your front heel to come back.
Common mistake: leaning your torso forward.

name: Barbell Walking Lunge
cue: Move forward, alternating legs with long steps.
imageNote: The image shows a stationary lunge; here you walk forward.

name: Walking Lunge
cue:
Standing tall, take a long step forward.
Lower until your back knee almost touches the floor.
Push through your front heel and step forward with the other leg.
Common mistake: taking very short steps or letting your front knee cave in.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
cue: Step back; easier on the knees.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
cue:
Back foot on a bench and front foot a long step ahead.
A dumbbell in each hand and torso upright.
Lower straight down until your back knee almost touches the floor.
Drive up through your front heel; finish your reps and switch legs.
Common mistake: putting your front foot too close to the bench.

name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
cue: Back foot elevated; lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
cue: Step up by pushing through the heel of your top leg.
imageNote: The image shows the bodyweight version; here you hold a dumbbell in each hand.

name: Barbell Step-Up
cue: Torso upright; don't push off with your bottom leg.
imageNote: The image shows the bodyweight version; here you carry the bar on your back.

name: Sissy Squat
cue: Lean your torso back and drive your knees forward.
imageNote: The image shows the bodyweight version.

name: Pistol Squat
cue: One leg straight out in front; squat down on a single leg.

name: Jump Squat
cue: Squat down and jump explosively; land softly.

name: Mountain Climber
cue: Plank position; drive your knees to your chest, alternating fast.

name: Romanian Deadlift
cue:
Stand with the bar in front of your thighs and feet hip-width apart.
Knees slightly bent and back straight the whole time.
Push your hips back and lower the bar close to your legs.
When you feel the back of your thighs stretch, stand up squeezing your glutes.
Common mistake: rounding your back or bending your knees too much.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
cue: Legs almost straight; neutral spine.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cue:
Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Knees slightly bent and back straight.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells close to your legs.
When you feel the stretch in the back of your thighs, stand up squeezing your glutes.
Common mistake: rounding your back to go lower.

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
cue:
Stand close to the bar with your feet hip-width apart.
Knees slightly bent and back straight.
Push your hips back and lower the bar, brushing your legs.
Stand up by driving your hips forward and squeezing your glutes.
Common mistake: rounding your back or going lower than your flexibility allows.

name: Single-Leg Deadlift
cue: Your free leg rises behind you as your torso lowers.

name: Lying Leg Curl
cue: Hips pressed to the bench; curl toward your glutes.

name: Seated Leg Curl
cue:
Adjust the backrest so your knee lines up with the machine's pivot.
Place the roller on your ankles and lower the pad onto your thighs.
Bend your knees, pulling your heels down and back.
Return slowly until your legs are almost straight.
Common mistake: lifting your hips off the seat.

name: Standing Leg Curl
cue: One leg at a time; control the extension.
imageNote: The image shows the band version; here you use the standing leg curl machine.

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
cue: Hips up; pull the ball toward you with your heels.

name: Glute Ham Raise
cue: Lower your torso, controlling it with your hamstrings, and come back up.
imageNote: The image shows the Nordic curl on the machine; the glute ham raise is very similar.

name: Nordic Curl
cue:
Kneel with your ankles anchored under a sturdy support or held by a partner.
Body straight from knees to head and glutes squeezed.
Lean forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands at the end and push back up.
Common mistake: bending at the hips instead of lowering in a straight line.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Swing
cue: Drive with your hips, not your arms.

name: Power Clean
cue: Explosive hip extension and catch the bar on your shoulders.

name: Clean Deadlift
cue: Clean grip; lift the bar with a tight back.
imageNote: The image shows a regular deadlift; here you use a clean grip.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cue:
Upper back on a bench and the bar over your hips (with a pad).
Feet hip-width apart; at the top your knees are at 90°.
Drive through your heels and raise your hips until they line up with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes for a second and lower under control.
Common mistake: arching your lower back instead of lifting with your glutes.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
cue: From the floor; raise your hips without arching your lower back.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cue:
Lie on your back, one foot planted and the other leg straight up.
Drive through the heel of your planted foot and raise your hips.
Keep your hips level, without tilting.
Lower slowly and repeat; then switch legs.
Common mistake: pushing with your back instead of your glute.

name: Glute Bridge
cue:
Lie on your back, knees bent and heels close to your glutes.
Arms at your sides on the floor.
Drive through your heels and raise your hips until they line up with your knees and shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly.
Common mistake: arching your lower back.

name: Glute Kickback
cue: On all fours; push your heel toward the ceiling.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
cue: Ankle strap on the low pulley; kick your leg back without arching.

name: Cable Pull-Through
cue: Back to the pulley; extend your hips, squeezing your glutes.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
cue: Push your legs apart against the resistance and return slowly.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
cue: Squeeze your legs together and control the way out.

name: Band Monster Walk
cue: Band around your ankles or knees; side steps with tension.

name: Standing Machine Calf Raise
cue:
Shoulders under the pads and the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform.
Knees straight, without locking them.
Lower your heels until you feel the stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can and squeeze for a second.
Common mistake: bending your knees to push.

name: Seated Calf Raise
cue: Knees under the pad; pause at the top.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
cue:
Stand with the ball of one foot on a step and the dumbbell in the hand on the same side.
Hold on to something with your other hand so you don't lose your balance.
Lower your heel until you feel the stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can and pause.
Common mistake: bouncing at the bottom.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
cue: Only the balls of your feet on the platform; push with your ankles.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
cue: Balls of your feet on a plate; full range of motion.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
cue: Torso bent forward; get a deep stretch at the bottom.

name: Barbell Calf Raise
cue: Bar on your back; rise onto your toes without bending your knees.

name: Crunch
cue:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Put your hands on your chest or touching your temples, without interlacing them.
Breathe out and lift your shoulders off the floor, squeezing your abs.
Lower slowly without fully resting your head.
Common mistake: pulling on your neck with your hands.

name: Cable Crunch
cue:
Kneel facing the high pulley and hold the rope next to your head.
Keep your hips still and bring your elbows toward your thighs, rounding your back.
Come up slowly until you feel your abs stretch.
Common mistake: sitting back on your heels and pulling with your hips.

name: Lying Knee Raise
cue: Knees bent; bring your knees to your chest using your abs and lower slowly, without momentum.

name: Machine Crunch
cue:
Set the seat so the pads rest on your chest or shoulders.
Bring your chest toward your hips, squeezing your abs.
Pause at the bottom and return slowly.
Common mistake: pushing with your arms instead of your abs.

name: Weighted Crunch
cue: Plate on your chest; come up under control.

name: Decline Crunch
cue: Feet secured; come up slowly.

name: Reverse Crunch
cue: Bring your knees to your chest, lifting your hips.

name: Oblique Crunch
cue: Bring your elbow toward the opposite knee.

name: Sit-Up
cue: Raise your whole torso until you're sitting up.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cue: Hanging from the bar; raise your legs without swinging.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
cue: Forearms supported; raise your knees to your chest.
imageNote: The image shows the captain's chair (with a backrest); on parallel bars the movement is the same.

name: Lying Leg Raise
cue:
Lie on your back with your hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor or bench.
Raise your legs, almost straight, until they're vertical.
Lower them slowly without touching the floor.
Common mistake: arching your lower back on the way down.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cue: From your knees; roll forward without arching your back.

name: Barbell Rollout
cue: Bar with plates; roll forward and come back using your abs.

name: Plank
cue: Elbows under your shoulders; body straight, squeeze your abs and glutes.

name: Side Plank
cue: Elbow under your shoulder; hips up in a straight line.

name: Russian Twist
cue: Torso leaning back; rotate from side to side.

name: Dead Bug
cue: Lower back pressed to the floor; extend the opposite arm and leg.

name: Pallof Press
cue: Sideways to the pulley; press forward, resisting the rotation.

name: Cable Woodchop
cue: Rotate your torso, pulling the cable on a diagonal.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
cue: Lean to one side and come back up using your oblique.

name: Hanging Pike
cue: Raise your feet toward the bar with straight legs.

name: Kettlebell Thruster
cue: Squat and press overhead in one movement.
imageNote: The image shows a barbell; here you use a kettlebell.

name: Clean and Press
cue: Clean the bar to your shoulders and press it overhead.
imageNote: The image shows dumbbells; here you use a barbell.

name: Battle Ropes
cue: Fast waves alternating arms with your knees bent.

name: Rope Climb
cue: Use your legs and arms to climb with control.

name: Muscle-Up
cue: Explosive pull and transition over the bar.

name: Turkish Get-Up
cue: Keep the arm with the kettlebell vertical the whole time; move in stages.

name: Box Jump
cue: Jump with both feet and land softly on the box.

name: Treadmill
cue:
Start by walking for 3 to 5 minutes to warm up.
Raise the speed or incline little by little.
Enter the time in seconds (20 min = 1200).
Common mistake: holding on to the handrails the whole time.
imageNote: The image shows the treadmill on an incline; you can also walk with no incline.

name: Stationary Bike
cue:
Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent with the pedal at the bottom.
Pedal at a pace where you can talk in short sentences.
Enter the time in seconds (20 min = 1200).
Common mistake: the seat too low (it bothers your knees).

name: Elliptical
cue:
Stand tall with your whole feet on the pedals.
Move your arms and legs at the same pace.
Enter the time in seconds (20 min = 1200).
Common mistake: leaning on the handles.

name: Stair Climber
cue:
Climb at a steady pace with your back straight.
Put your whole foot on each step.
Enter the time in seconds (10 min = 600).
Common mistake: putting your weight on the handrails.

name: Rowing Machine
cue:
Push with your legs first, then lean your torso back slightly and finish by pulling with your arms.
Return in the opposite order: arms, torso and legs.
Enter the time in seconds (10 min = 600).
Common mistake: pulling with your arms before pushing with your legs.

name: Jump Rope
cue:
Small jumps on the balls of your feet.
Turn the rope with your wrists, elbows close to your body.
Enter the time in seconds (1 min = 60).
Common mistake: jumping too high and tiring out fast.
